intro: Little Lhasa in the Dhauladhar hills. That is McLeodganj in one line — but there is a lot more to it. This guide covers when to go, where to stay and what not to miss.

sections.heading: Why visit McLeodganj
paragraphs: McLeodganj (Himachal Pradesh) is known for its mountain, spiritual and trek experiences. Overall it is budget-friendly — hostels, homestays and local food keep costs low.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is March to June and September to November.

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Fly to Dharamshala (Gaggal) or take an overnight bus from Delhi.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Start the Triund trek early to beat the afternoon clouds.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit McLeodganj?
faq.a: March to June and September to November.
Fly to Dharamshala (Gaggal) or take an overnight bus from Delhi.

faq.q: Where should I stay in McLeodganj?
faq.a: Popular choices: McLeodganj for cafés; Bhagsu and Dharamkot for quiet.
